title: Kitai Pay
tagline: Experience hassle-free subscription management with our cutting-edge platform powered by Superfluid SDK. Seamlessly create, manage, and maintain subscriptions across multiple blockchain networks and tokens. Simplify your subscription process for individuals and businesses.
description:
In the development of our applications, we have leveraged the power of Next.js, a highly efficient JavaScript framework, along with the versatile Next UI components to construct the frontend. Next.js has been instrumental in providing us with server-side rendering, static site generation, and numerous other features that greatly enhance the performance and development experience of our applications. With Next UI components, we have been able to swiftly create visually appealing and interactive user interface elements, thereby enhancing the overall user experience.

To seamlessly manage the subscription functionality within our applications, we have diligently integrated all the functions offered by the Superfluid SDK. This comprehensive software development kit equips us with a rich set of tools and utilities specifically designed for handling subscriptions, especially in the decentralized finance (DeFi) domain. By leveraging the capabilities of the Superfluid SDK, our applications effectively process payments, manage subscriptions, and perform other essential subscription-related tasks, ensuring a seamless and efficient user experience.

To retrieve and present relevant subscription data to our users, we rely on the powerful Superfluid subgraph. By utilizing this subgraph, which is a pre-defined schema and set of queries provided by Superfluid, we can efficiently query the blockchain data pertaining to subscriptions. This data, once obtained, is seamlessly displayed within our applications, ensuring that our users have access to up-to-date and pertinent information regarding their subscriptions. The integration of Superfluid's subgraph has greatly simplified the process of querying and displaying data, contributing to a more intuitive and informative user interface.
how_its_made:
Welcome to our subscription management website, a platform designed to assist users in creating and maintaining subscriptions through the powerful Superfluid SDK. Our website offers a user-friendly interface and robust functionality to streamline the process of managing subscriptions for our users.

Currently, our platform is fully operational on the Polygon Mumbai Testnet, a popular Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution. Utilizing the fDAIx supertoken on this testnet, we provide users with a seamless experience to create and manage their subscriptions. By leveraging the capabilities of the Superfluid SDK, we empower our users to effortlessly handle subscription-related tasks, such as initiating payments, modifying subscription parameters, and tracking subscription statuses.

However, our ambitions extend beyond a single blockchain network and token. In our roadmap, we have plans to expand our platform's compatibility to include various other blockchain networks, such as Ethereum Mainnet, Binance Smart Chain, and more. This expansion will enable users to utilize different tokens and currencies, broadening the range of options available for their subscriptions.

By incorporating additional chains and tokens, we aim to enhance the versatility and flexibility of our platform, catering to a wider user base with diverse preferences and requirements. This expansion will provide our users with the freedom to choose the blockchain network and token that best aligns with their needs, promoting a more inclusive and customizable subscription management experience.

We are committed to constantly improving our platform, incorporating user feedback, and staying up to date with the latest advancements in the blockchain ecosystem. Through our continuous efforts, we strive to make subscription management accessible, efficient, and secure for users across multiple blockchain networks and tokens, empowering them to enjoy seamless subscription experiences tailored to their preferences and requirements.
